[SWS_TcpIp_00204] ⌈For transmissions the TcpIp Module shall skip the calculation
of the protocol checksums and fill the field with the value 0 for frames with respect to
the configuration of the Ethernet Controller according the following list:
• for IPv4 frames that have no additional IPv4 option if IPv4 checksum calculation
in hardware is enabled, i.e. EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumIPv4 is set to
TRUE
• for not fragmented and not IpSec secured ICMP frames that have no additional
IPv4 option or IPv6 header if ICMP checksum calculation in hardware is enabled,
EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumICMP is set to TRUE
• for not IpSec secured TCP frames that have no additional IPv4 option or IPv6
header if TCP checksum calculation in hardware is enabled, EthCtrlEnable-
OffloadChecksumTCP is set to TRUE
• for not fragmented and not IpSec secured UDP frames that have no additional
IPv4 option or IPv6 header if UDP checksum calculation in hardware is enabled,
EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumUDP is set to TRUE
In all other cases, the TcpIp module shall calculate the checksum according the related
protocol specification.⌋
